column1: # Golden set for modules/system/homebeacon, first pass 2026-09-26.
# Judged against the source, not against how well the sentence reads. A
# claim is y when a reviewer would take it into a pull request unchanged.
# Baseline this scores: llmq-claims against qwen2.5-coder 7B on
# llama-server, min 3, max 4 claims per subject, 700-token cap, one request
# per subject over a shared prefix held in the server's cache. 16 claims
# produced, 8 survived the machine checks, 6 accepted here, 36 minutes,
# 0.73 tok/s. End-to-end yield 6 of 16, about six minutes per shipped
# claim.
# The two rejections share one cause: the model supplied a rationale the
# text does not give. Line 1 smooths over a firewall rule it did not
# understand ("binds to a broad address for exposure control"); line 3
# takes the impersonation argument from genkey.nix's comment about
# regeneration and attaches it to keycheck in default.nix. Both read well,
# which is what makes them dangerous. Everything accepted below can be
# traced to a line in the file it is about.
# verdict
n
column4: The module configures a service to respond to presence challenges on a LAN-facing port and binds to a broad address for exposure control.
